==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|re-|place|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈpleɪs/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-replace.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈplæɪs/|a=AU}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪs|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[restore]] to a former [[place]], position, condition, etc.; to [[put back]].
#: {{ux|en|When you've finished using the telephone, please '''replace''' the handset.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[refund]]; to [[repay]]; to [[pay back]].
#: {{ux|en|You can take what you need from the petty cash, but you must '''replace''' it tomorrow morning.}}
#* {{RQ:Bramah Max Carrados Mysteries|passage='Of course I should like to '''replace''' the damage,' said the delinquent.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[supply]] or [[substitute]] an [[equivalent]] with.
#: {{ux|en|I '''replaced''' my car with a newer model.}}
#: {{ux|en|The batteries were dead so I '''replaced''' them.}}
#* {{RQ:Guardian|date=20 September 2012|author=Andrew Brown|title=Archbishop of Canterbury succession race begins in earnest|url=http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2012/sep/20/archbishop-of-canterbury-succession-rowan-williams|passage=Next Wednesday, four women and 15 men on the Crown Nominations Commission will gather for two days of prayer and horsetrading to '''replace''' Rowan Williams as archbishop of Canterbury.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261027130535/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2012/sep/20/archbishop-of-canterbury-succession-rowan-williams|archivedate=27 October 2026}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To take over the [[position]] or [[role]] from.
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To take the place of; to be used instead of.
#: {{ux|en|This security pass '''replaces''' the one you were given earlier.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1845|author=w:William Whewell|title=The Elements of Morality: Including Polity
|passage=''This duty of right intention does not '''replace''' or supersede the duty of consideration.''}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To demolish (a building) and build an updated form of that building in its place.
# {{lb|en|transitive|rare}} To place again.
# {{lb|en|transitive|rare}} To put in a new or different place.

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|stem=replac|old=1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|to supply or substitute an equivalent for}} {{l|en|exchange}}, {{l|en|swap}}; See also [[Thesaurus:switch]]
